method: DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.5 bundled CLI, isolated DSH_HOME and SQLite, real DSH agents and service, loopback synthetic model
surface_boundary: Original rc.5 CLI scope receipt predates the privacy correction. The separate regression exercises the registered native tool result and renderer used by session history. It does not repeat a full Desktop ZIP export.

privacy_correction.initial_finding: A standard DSH session export can contain text returned by a native tool renderer. The previous registered notes tool returned the private fixture in both execute text and rendered history.
privacy_correction.observed_after: The same source session receives only shared notes. The persisted private fixture is retained and omitted from execute text/preview and rendered tool result. Requests to create new brain-only notes receive SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.
privacy_correction.availability: Existing brain-only records remain private under the original retention policy. A separately verified, non-exportable model read channel is still unavailable.
privacy_correction.regression: tests/integration/chat-native.spec.ts (keeps brain-only notes out of native result and conversation export content); tests/contract/run-notes.spec.ts
